text: Lawson, Inc. (株式会社ローソン) announced on 6 February 2024 a capital and business alliance under which Mitsubishi Corporation and KDDI Corporation each hold 50% of Lawson's voting rights following its privatisation (takeover bid and squeeze-out, completed in 2024).
short: Lawson is held 50/50 by Mitsubishi Corporation and KDDI Corporation.

source.name: 株式会社ローソン: 三菱商事・KDDI・ローソン、資本業務提携契約を締結 (capital alliance announcement)
source.quote: 本取引の完了後、三菱商事とKDDIは、ローソンの議決権を50%ずつ保有し
